Author: ocealot
Name: AureliusJobBars
Description:
Additional job gauges, party buff timers, mitigation trackers, and more. Icon by PAPACHIN

Fork of 0ceal0t/JobBars: hovering an icon on the Buffs or Cooldowns bar shows the game's own action tooltip. Toggle per bar in /jobbars. Ships under its own InternalName because Dalamud blocks custom repos from serving names the official repo lists.
Punchline: Extra job gauges, with native action tooltips on hover
Changelog: Native action tooltips on the Buffs and Cooldowns bars via KamiToolKit NodeBase.ActionTooltip. Toggle per bar in /jobbars (default on). Tooltips add NodeFlags.HasCollision, so the icons capture the mouse.
